sentences.text: Transistors are the building blocks of all modern electronics, serving two main functions: switching and amplification.
Bipolar Junction Transistors (BJTs) are current-controlled devices.
A small base current Ib controls a large collector current Ic according to the current gain: Ic = beta × Ib. MOSFETs are voltage-controlled devices.
A voltage applied between Gate and Source (VGS) opens a conductive channel between Drain and Source, with virtually zero gate current.
Because MOSFETs require no continuous gate current and have ultra-low on-resistance RDS(on), they dominate modern high-power switching.
